meta.scenario: Three fluid tanks in a column: basic (0, bottom), advanced (1) and basic (2, top). 20000 of water in the top one at 0; the top one goes active at 5 and the middle one at 20; the middle one goes inactive at 40. At 50, 40000 of water pushed into the top face of the bottom tank (overflows up, the valve of the bottom one), at 52 500 more, at 60 100000 pushed into the north face of the bottom tank, at 70 lava pushed into the top of the bottom one (refused), at 75 3000 pulled from the bottom face of the bottom tank and at 80 from the south face of the top one. The top tank goes active at 85.
meta.fields: t; marks (the actions of the tick, run in ServerTickEvent.Pre); results (what each push and pull moved, in mark order; -1 with no capability on that side); tanks, bottom first: fluid, amount, scale (prevScale), comparator (getCurrentRedstoneLevel), active, mode (ContainerEditMode), valve (getValveFluid), in and out as [item, count, fluid of the item, mB, chemical of the item, mB] (null when the tile is gone); drops: {t, nbt (saveWithFullMetadata), stacks (ItemStack.CODEC)} of each break.
